comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-1970 loads four connector modules into a sprung hinged frame and clicks it shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests two-tool countertorque; PR-1970 tests repeated narrow-pitch placement, maintaining multiple loose modules on small support edges, and closing a sprung frame around them.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained angle after actuation; PR-1970 grades module seating/lug engagement, frame click, absence of forced closure, and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: The connector task tests multi-part seating through enclosure closure, not preservation of an adjustable stop.
